channel.title: Haohan Wang's blog
channel.description: Personal perspectives on AI research, trustworthy AI, AI for science, and teaching.

item.title: Sounding Like You Know
item.description: Frontier models are getting better at sounding right. In biology, where answers are slow to check, that fluency is harder to catch than a plain error.

item.title: Math Is Not Just Problem Solving
item.description: AI can now write research-level math proofs. Our new study asks whether models also track the hidden hypotheses that learning math trains us to notice.

item.title: Vision Should Be Structural
item.description: Why my group spent a few years turning images into SVG code that language models can read, and what I think still holds.

item.title: A Unified View of Trustworthy AI
item.description: Robustness, fairness, and interpretability are usually studied apart, but many of their methods answer the same question about data.

item.title: We Evaluate Prompt-Injection Defenses Too Simply
item.description: A low attack success rate can mean a model handled untrusted text correctly, or that it threw the text away, and the standard metric does not say which.
